items.title: John Pope Interview, 1959-05-01
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...He was in Lipson. Lipson was really his teacher. ... [INTERVIEWEE] His name was Charlie Lipson. That's right. He did teach Cootie.

ctx.x: I was asking about the Cootie Williams teacher. This man did teach Cootie. He was in Lipson. Lipson was really his teacher. I didn't know for sure if that was true.
His name was Charlie Lipson. That's right. He did teach Cootie.
